Location: 1222 N Bishop Ave Ste 600, Dallas, TX 75208

Specialties: Harvard-trained, board-certified, Platinum Invisalign provider, DFW top orthodontist multiple years running.
Locations: 1110 N Buckner Blvd & 10230 Midway Rd, Dallas, TX

Traditional or Clear Braces: Best for complex bite issues, severe crowding, or younger patients where compliance with removable aligners is a concern.
